read.thesis: Sales up 7.9% to $6.86B and adjusted EPS guide narrowed to $11.85–$12.15, but price-cost is squeezed and management says demand stays soft into 2027 with few positive catalysts.

triggers.label: PSG price increase 8% effective Sept 1
triggers.quote: The 8% price increase that became effective September 1 is tracking as planned

triggers.label: Few positive catalysts into 2027
triggers.quote: The leading indicators we track point to few positive catalysts at this time.

triggers.label: FY26 EPS range narrowed, midpoint held at $12
triggers.quote: narrowing our earnings outlook and now expect adjusted diluted net income per share to be in the range of $11.85 to $12.15

triggers.label: 2027 cost savings ~$75M
triggers.quote: We expect cost savings of approximately $75 million in 2027

guidance.quote: narrowing our earnings outlook and now expect adjusted diluted net income per share to be in the range of $11.85 to $12.15 per share
we expect raw material inflation to be in the low to mid single digit range for 2027
We expect cost savings of approximately $75 million in 2027
We expect to be back in our typical range of 80 to 100 net new stores starting in 2027.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We are maintaining the midpoint of our full year adjusted diluted EPS guidance which we raised in July.

red_flags.label: Sales-to-earnings conversion below standard
red_flags.quote: we acknowledge that the sales to earning conversion in the quarter was below our standard

red_flags.label: Gross margin down ~430bp adjusted
red_flags.quote: yeah, you are 430 basis points, backwards

red_flags.label: Management says pricing alone may not cover inflation
red_flags.quote: you should expect us to act with discipline and urgency

evasions.quote: we are not announcing anything on our call today
we generally do not break out the price mix component
